items.originalTitle: Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) Upgraded to "Buy" at Wall Street Zen
items.originalSummary: After market close Thursday, Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) delivered a beat-and-raise quarter, posting double-digit percentage gains in key fundamentals. It also notched new records in certain line items. So, given all that winning, the stock logically traded higher the following day, right? Wrong. Investors, accustomed to robust growth and estimates-beating quarters from tech hardware companies, found several developments in the earnings report concerning. Meanwhile, events outside of the company's control were putting the hurt on industry stocks on Friday, and Cisco's shares fell by more than 6%. That's quite the dichotomy, so here's a look at where that places the stock just now. Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

items.originalTitle: Cisco Systems Raises Outlook On Soaring Revenue, Profit
items.originalSummary: By Natalie Weger Cisco Systems raised its outlook for the year after revenue and profit soared in its latest quarter, driven by high demand in the agentic artificial-intelligence market. The networking-equipment company on Thursday posted a first-quarter profit of $4.55 billion, or $1.14 a share, compared with $2.86 billion, or 72 cents a share, the year earlier. On an adjusted basis, per-share earnings were $1.40, topping the $1.33 a share analysts were expecting, according to FactSet. Revenue climbed 24% to $18.52 billion, beating the $18.12 billion analysts polled by FactSet were expecting. Product revenue rose 32% and services revenue increased 1%, with revenues up across all geographic segments. The company raised its 2027 expectation for AI infrastructure revenue from hyperscalers to $9 billion, more than double the total for 2026. Chief Executive Chuck Robbins said that organizations are turning to Cisco to help them scale, secure and optimize their environments for use in the agentic AI era. "We are in the very early stages of a multi-year networking supercycle, and we're confident in our ability to continue capturing the multi-billion-dollar opportunity it represents for Cisco," Robbins said. The company now expects full-year revenue between $74.8 billion and $75.8 billion and full-year adjusted earnings per share between $5.47 and $5.53. The company previously forecasted revenue between $72.2 billion and $73.4 billion on adjusted earnings of between $5.05 and $5.11 a share. For the current second quarter, Cisco guided for revenue from $18 billion to $18.2 billion and adjusted earnings of $1.34 and $1.36 a share. Analysts expect revenue of $17.85 billion and adjusted earnings of $1.23 a share. Write to Natalie Weger at natalie.weger@wsj.com. (END) Dow Jones Newswires 11-12-26 1657ET

items.title: Microsoft Outlook 中斷和 FAA Groundstop 表示對脆弱技術的依賴
items.originalTitle: Microsoft Outlook Outage and FAA Groundstop Show Dependence on Fragile Technology
items.originalSummary: The Federal Aviation Administration on Friday issued a rare nationwide ground stop due to "extraordinary circumstances" caused by communications problems at regional air traffic control centers. It's the second time since Sept. 11, 2001, that the FAA has issued such an order. The last was January 2023, when a key FAA computer system malfunctioned. The world-stopping news comes just a day after a massive Microsoft outage left thousands of users without access to Outlook, the company's email platform. According to Downdetector, reports peaked at 130,000 users impacted, though other estimates say it was closer to millions. These two events, both stemming from apparently complicated technological issues, happening so close to each other have left many wondering whether they are connected. However, Microsoft and the federal government have denied any connection. Hours after the ground stop was put in place, Microsoft released a statement on social media. "We have no indication that the FAA’s nationwide ground stop is related to any Microsoft services," the company wrote. Department of Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin also rejected the link. Responding to questions Friday afternoon outside the White House, Mullin said they are "separate issues," and that he didn't see “any reason to connect those two at all.”

items.originalTitle: Firefly Aerospace Inks $1.3 Billion Deal With AST SpaceMobile for Rocket Engines
items.originalSummary: Firefly Aerospace has signed an agreement valued at more than $1.3 billion with AST SpaceMobile to supply rocket engines, license engine intellectual property, and provide engineering support for AST SpaceMobile’s new heavy-lift launch vehicle. The three-year agreement includes the delivery of 36 rocket engines and provides AST SpaceMobile with rights to manufacture engines using Firefly’s technology. The transaction represents a substantial commercial agreement for Firefly and supports AST SpaceMobile’s strategy of developing its own launch infrastructure for satellite deployments. Under the agreement, Firefly will provide 27 Miranda engines and nine Vira vacuum engines for AST SpaceMobile’s first three rockets. The engines will support development of a new heavy-lift launch vehicle intended to deploy AST SpaceMobile’s BlueBird satellites into low Earth orbit. AST SpaceMobile is developing a space-based cellular broadband network designed to provide connectivity directly to standard mobile devices. The company requires substantial launch capacity to deploy its satellite constellation and expand network coverage. Developing its own launch vehicle could provide greater control over launch schedules and reduce dependence on third-party rocket availability. Firefly will supply the propulsion technology while maintaining ownership of its underlying intellectual property. AST SpaceMobile will receive a license allowing it to manufacture the engines for its launch program.

historyItems.summary: Firefly Aerospace 與 AST SpaceMobile 簽署了一份價值超過 13 億美元的協議，為 AST SpaceMobile 的新型重型運載火箭提供火箭發動機、許可發動機知識產權並提供工程支援。這份為期三年的協議包括交付 36 台火箭發動機，並為 AST SpaceMobile 提供使用 Firefly 技術製造發動機的權利。該交易代表了 Firefly 的一項重要商業協議，並支援 AST SpaceMobile 開發自己的衛星部署發射基礎設施的策略。根據協議，Firefly 將為 AST SpaceMobile 的前三枚火箭提供 27 台 Miranda 引擎和 9 台 Vira 真空引擎。
historyItems.originalTitle: Firefly Aerospace Inks $1.3 Billion Deal With AST SpaceMobile for Rocket Engines
historyItems.originalSummary: Firefly Aerospace has signed an agreement valued at more than $1.3 billion with AST SpaceMobile to supply rocket engines, license engine intellectual property, and provide engineering support for AST SpaceMobile’s new heavy-lift launch vehicle. The three-year agreement includes the delivery of 36 rocket engines and provides AST SpaceMobile with rights to manufacture engines using Firefly’s technology. The transaction represents a substantial commercial agreement for Firefly and supports AST SpaceMobile’s strategy of developing its own launch infrastructure for satellite deployments. Under the agreement, Firefly will provide 27 Miranda engines and nine Vira vacuum engines for AST SpaceMobile’s first three rockets. The engines will support development of a new heavy-lift launch vehicle intended to deploy AST SpaceMobile’s BlueBird satellites into low Earth orbit. AST SpaceMobile is developing a space-based cellular broadband network designed to provide connectivity directly to standard mobile devices. The company requires substantial launch capacity to deploy its satellite constellation and expand network coverage. Developing its own launch vehicle could provide greater control over launch schedules and reduce dependence on third-party rocket availability. Firefly will supply the propulsion technology while maintaining ownership of its underlying intellectual property. AST SpaceMobile will receive a license allowing it to manufacture the engines for its launch program.

historyItems.originalTitle: Centrus Energy (LEU) Stock May Look Rich Despite A New Fuel Supply Deal
historyItems.originalSummary: Centrus Energy has swung sharply in recent years, and the question now is whether the current share price still matches what its earnings can justify. After a long run and a tough year, investors are asking if the earnings power of the business lines up with where the stock trades today. Over the past 3 years the stock has gained 97.6%, which puts real pressure on the earnings story to support that kind of step up in valuation. Fresh fuel supply agreements for Oklo's planned Aurora powerhouses in Ohio may support future enrichment volumes and could influence how investors think about Centrus Energy's earnings visibility and capital needs. historyItems.originalSummary: The lawsuit alleges Fluence Energy's fiscal 2026 guidance rested on contract manufacturing facilities that were not ready to produce at assumed volumes. Three heavy-volume selloffs followed as that alleged gap surfaced, and this release measures the market impact of each. NEW YORK , Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SueWallSt alerts investors in Fluence Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLNC ) of a pending securities class action on behalf of purchasers of Fluence Energy securities between November 24, 2025 and September 16, 2026. Find out if you may qualify to recover losses or contact Joseph E. Levi, Esq. at [email protected] or (888) SueWallSt. FLNC closed at $28.99 on February 4, 2026, and faltered to just $18.95 the following day, a decline of $10.04 per share, or about 34.63%. The complaint highlights two further declines of about $1.02, or 7.17% on August 6, 2026 and of $1.39, or about 15.36% on September 17, 2026. To be considered for lead plaintiff, investors must file by November 27, 2026. The Market Impact of Each FLNC Disclosure Day As averred, the decline unfolded in stages because Fluence Energy reaffirmed its fiscal 2026 outlook alongside the February 4, 2026 results and again on May 6, 2026. The pleading asserts that the Company did not disclose that delivering backlog and recognizing guided revenue depended on new contract manufacturing facilities that were not completed, not operational, or not capable of the assumed volumes. It further asserts that corrective measures at the Company's contract manufacturers were not remediating the production problems. The complaint charges that the August 5, 2026 report, which blamed weaker revenue on "production delays at new contract manufacturing facilities," and the September 16, 2026 update, which cited "continuing supply chain issues affecting the Company's U.S. production," each partially corrected those alleged misstatements. "Fluence Energy shareholders absorbed three heavy-volume selloffs in under eight months, and the complaint alleges each one followed news about contract manufacturing problems that had not been disclosed when guidance was set. Where an outlook is reaffirmed between those declines, investors are entitled to ask what management knew about production readiness at the time." -- Joseph E. Levi, Esq. historyItems.originalTitle: Exclusive | Meta Testing New Prediction-Market App With Employees
historyItems.originalSummary: Meta (META) is testing Takes, a play-money prediction app, with employees, and AI-written questions target the hand-picked cost that killed its 2020 Forecast app. A free Meta product would threaten Robinhood's retail engagement far more than CME's institutional futures franchise, since it competes for attention and daily habit. Takes may never ship and carries no disclosed revenue, while Meta's $135-145B capital spending is the bigger story for investors. On the night of November 13, 2026, Meta Platforms ( NASDAQ:META ) employees were asked to predict who would win the quiz show Jeopardy! inside an unreleased app called Takes. The test appeared that afternoon, and Meta declined to comment and gave no launch date.

historyItems.originalTitle: Teradyne Benefits From Strong Test Demand: Can It Beat KLAC & COHU?
historyItems.originalSummary: Teradyne TER is benefiting from strong semiconductor test demand, accelerating artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure investments, and increasing complexity in advanced chip architectures. Rising demand for AI accelerators, high-bandwidth memory (HBM), and high-performance computing solutions is strengthening the company's growth prospects and competitive position against KLA KLAC and Cohu COHU. Teradyne reported impressive third-quarter 2026 results, with revenues surging 70% year over year to $1.31 billion. Semiconductor Test revenues increased 77% to more than $1 billion, supported by robust demand for AI accelerators, high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and power management solutions. Compute revenues grew nearly 50%, while memory revenues reached a record $301 million, reflecting strong demand for HBM and DRAM testing. Teradyne's expanding product portfolio is another key growth driver. The company's UltraFLEXplus platform is gaining traction as hyperscalers increasingly adopt dual-vendor testing strategies. Its recently introduced UltraVS64-HP, UltraPort-PCIe6 and Magnum E2 solutions strengthen its ability to address next-generation AI accelerators, high-speed connectivity and advanced memory testing requirements. Teradyne expects additional hyperscaler capacity purchases and compute-related revenue opportunities in 2027. Teradyne's expanding AI-driven opportunities and product innovations position it favorably to sustain momentum against KLAC and COHU. For the fourth quarter of 2026, Teradyne expects revenues between $1.25 billion and $1.35 billion. The midpoint of the guidance range stands at $1.30 billion.

historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX’s Starship Launch Today Could Lift the Stock
historyItems.originalSummary: If you find yourself in Texas during the next flight of SpaceX's massive Starship rocket , you may be in for quite a show. Anytime the world's largest rocket is due to get off the ground at SpaceX's Starbase headquarters in Boca Chica, a crowd is sure to form at the nearby South Padre Island . This time, though, it may not be just the launch of Starship that attracts spectators, but the possible return a day later of the rocket's upper section to South Texas. Up until now, SpaceX has sought to land the upper stage vehicle in distant oceans after it hits its objectives and completes its test flights. In some infamous cases, the vehicle has even accidentally exploded in the air mid-flight. For the first time, though, the plan is for both Starship's stages to travel back to Starbase after doing their jobs. And in the case of the upper stage, that dramatic landmark homecoming should take it over a large swath of Texas . Here's where you can watch SpaceX conduct its next Starship flight test from Starbase, Texas, as well as what to expect for a mission referred to as flight 15 . SpaceX, which tech mogul Elon Musk founded in 2002, is developing Starship to be a fully reusable transportation system, meaning both the rocket and vehicle can return to the ground for additional missions. Reaching 407 feet tall when fully stacked, Starship is regarded as the largest and most powerful launch vehicle ever developed. The rocket is composed of both the 236-foot lower stage booster known as Super Heavy that provides the initial burst of thrust at liftoff, and a 171-foot upper stage that flies in orbit. The third and latest prototype of Starship, known as Version 3 (V3) is still undergoing test flights as SpaceX races to have it ready for NASA's Artemis lunar landings and Musk's own dreams of crewed trips to Mars . Starship is also central to SpaceX's plans of expanding its Starlink satellite internet business. SpaceX is working toward a Friday, Nov. 13, launch of its Starship rocket, the company announced . The launch window is due to open from 4:45 to 6 p.m. CT. This time, though, spectators in Texas may want to make a point to not just catch the launch, but the return of the section of the rocket that flies in space nearly a day later (see more on that below).

historyItems.originalSummary: CHANTILLY, Va., 13 November 2026 | 14:00 PM Europe/Amsterdam Nokia Federal Solutions awarded Department of War RAPID contract to advance multi-domain threat awareness Press Release Nokia Federal Solutions today announced that it has been awarded a contract under the Department of War's (DoW) RAPID project, managed by the FutureG Office within the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering (OUSW(R&E)). The award supports Real-World Application Prototyping for ISAC Demonstration (RAPID), leveraging 5G and 6G infrastructure for object detection and tracking. Under the contract, Nokia Federal will develop, build and test integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) capabilities and demonstrate an end-to-end solution for the DoW's RAPID project. The effort supports the FutureG Office's mission by demonstrating how 5G and future 6G networks can be leveraged to improve threat detection and situational awareness, helping protect critical infrastructure against emerging threats. Built on Nokia's AI-RAN platform, the project will integrate Nokia and third-party applications for sensing and spectrum threat awareness. It will combine multiple sensing modalities and sensor fusion to help provide a more comprehensive picture of potential unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) threats. Subcontractors supporting the effort include Nokia affiliates, Texas Tech University, DeepSig, Hidden Level and Future Technologies. " The unmanned system threat is real. Integrated sensing and communications provides the opportunity to help protect critical infrastructure by leveraging the existing cellular networks to identify the threat. This project in partnership with Department of War is helping to advance the technology and the ecosystem to make that a reality. Steve Vogelsang, Chief Technology Officer, Nokia Federal Solutions " " In the FutureG Office, we are accelerating and adapting commercial wireless technologies to meet the requirements of the Department of War, and ISAC is at the forefront of this effort. Through RAPID and related initiatives, we are cultivating an open ecosystem that enables us to leverage commercial cellular infrastructure to bolster force protection and defense of critical assets against evolving UAV threats. Marlan Macklin, Deputy Principal Director for FutureG in OUSW(R&E) " The award reinforces Nokia Federal's role in supporting the DoW FutureG Office's mission by bringing proven commercial innovation into mission-critical environments. It also highlights how commercial technologies can be applied to meet the DoW's most demanding operational requirements. We build networks that connect intelligence and deliver a comprehensive connectivity solution across fixed, mobile, IP, optical, core, and data center networks. historyItems.originalTitle: ULA delays to Sunday Vulcan rocket launch of 40 Leo satellites for Amazon
historyItems.originalSummary: A United Launch Alliance Vulcan, equipped with six solid rocket boosters, stands ready for launch at Cape Canaveral's pad 41. The rocket will carry 40 Amazon Leo satellites to orbit. Image: Michael Cain/Spaceflight Now. Update: Launch has now slipped to Sunday at 12:11 p.m. EST (1711 UTC) due to a network communication issue between the ground and the rocket that could not be resolved in time for Saturday’s launch window. United Launch Alliance will try again Saturday to launch its Vulcan rocket after a power interruption at a nitrogen plant scrubbed Friday’s attempt, further postponing the 215-foot-tall vehicle’s return to flight after solid rocket booster nozzles failed on two of its first four missions. Liftoff from Space Launch Complex 41 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is now scheduled for 12:32:30 p.m. EST (1732:30 UTC) Saturday, Nov. 14. ULA said the rocket and the 40 Amazon Leo satellites it carries remain healthy. “The launch of a United Launch Alliance Vulcan rocket carrying the Amazon [LV-01] mission is delayed due to a power interruption in the Air Liquide gaseous nitrogen plant which resulted in the loss of their high-pressure pumps,” ULA said in a statement Friday morning. “Without confirmation of sustained commodity flow, the team has decided to realign the launch to the back-up opportunity.” Spaceflight Now will have live coverage Saturday beginning 30 minutes prior to liftoff. ULA announced the delay at 8:41 a.m. EST, a little more than four hours before the originally scheduled Friday liftoff and after the launch team had begun loading liquid oxygen into the rocket’s Centaur 5 upper stage, according to the company’s live mission updates. Gaseous nitrogen is used to purge and pressurize systems on the rocket and launchpad. The one-day delay extends a nine-month wait since the most recent solid rocket booster malfunction prompted the U.S. government to pause its use of the non-reusable rocket for national security missions. The now-delayed mission serves a private customer, Amazon, which has tasked ULA with ferrying 40 broadband internet satellites to expand its Leo constellation. It’s the first of 38 Vulcan launches Amazon has purchased. ULA has not said how long Saturday’s launch window will last. The rocket will fly on a northeasterly trajectory upon leaving the pad.

historyItems.title: SpaceX 的巨型火箭可能會讓 NASA 望塵莫及
historyItems.summary: 今天晚些時候，SpaceX 正計劃對其大型新型火箭星際飛船進行迄今為止最雄心勃勃的測試。如果一切順利，它將從德克薩斯州南部的一個發射場升空，環繞地球飛行，然後在 22 個半小時後垂直降落在同一個發射場。這項測試將成為火箭的一個重要里程碑，公司創辦人馬斯克表示，他希望有一天能將太空人送上火星。但專家表示，Starship 的快速發展最終也可能讓該公司多年來最大的支持者之一——美國太空總署 (NASA) 陷入困境。
historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX's giant rocket may leave NASA in the dust
historyItems.originalSummary: Later today, SpaceX is planning the most ambitious test yet of its massive new rocket Starship. If all goes well, it will lift off from a pad in South Texas, circle the Earth and then land vertically at the same pad 22 and a half hours later. The test would be a major milestone for a rocket that company founder Elon Musk says he hopes will one day carry astronauts to Mars. But experts say the rapid development of Starship could also end up stranding one of the company's biggest boosters over the years: NASA. That's because as SpaceX ramps up its new rocket, it has said it will stop flying a much smaller one called Falcon 9. Falcon 9 launches the company's Dragon capsule, which is currently the only American spacecraft capable of ferrying NASA astronauts to and from the International Space Station. "Because Dragon has become such a successful and reliable vehicle, it became the de facto way for astronauts to get to orbit," said Caleb Henry, director of research at Quilty Space, a firm that tracks the space industry. According to a NASA announcement in September, the space agency has contracted with SpaceX for three additional flights to the International Space Station. That would only allow Dragon to fly through 2028, assuming the missions were flown consecutively in six month increments and no further flights are contracted with SpaceX.

historyItems.summary: SpaceX (SPCX) 預計其德州和亞利桑那州的人工智慧園區價值超過 740 億美元，但股價幾乎沒有變動，因為大部分都是計畫支出。亞利桑那州是風險較高、規模較大的一半：透過空殼公司 Tombstone Resources 備案的約 500 億美元園區，沒有合約支持承諾的就業或帳單削減。 12 月 9 日，科奇斯縣分區聽證會將決定 740 億美元的計劃是否成立，或者亞利桑那州的一半是否會受到質疑。 2026 年 11 月 12 日，SpaceX（納斯達克股票代碼：SPCX）為其人工智慧擴張設定了單一價格。
historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX plans over $74 billion investment in Texas, Arizona AI campuses
historyItems.originalSummary: SpaceX (SPCX) pegs its Texas and Arizona AI campuses at over $74 billion, yet the shares barely moved because most of it is planned spending. Arizona is the riskier, larger half: a roughly $50 billion campus filed through shell company Tombstone Resources, with no contract backing promised jobs or bill cuts. A December 9 Cochise County zoning hearing decides whether the $74 billion plan holds or the Arizona half falls into doubt. On November 12, 2026, SpaceX ( NASDAQ:SPCX ) put a single price on its AI expansion. In a company update, it said a supercompute facility at Starbase in Texas' Rio Grande Valley and a campus in Cochise County, Arizona, together represent more than $74 billion in planned American investment.

historyItems.title: 建造火箭很難。 AST SpaceMobile 認為這很「簡單」。
historyItems.summary: 在周四長達一小時的活動中，電信公司 AST SpaceMobile 的創始人兼執行長 Abel Avellan 闡述了他開發大型火箭以將藍鳥衛星送入軌道的願景。阿維蘭一再強調，AST 計劃建造一枚「簡單」火箭。他多次引用 SpaceX 創始人埃隆馬斯克的話說：「最好的部分就是沒有部分。」阿維蘭強調，AST 已經為其擬議的 Blacklift 火箭採購了發動機，並聲稱發動機開發佔典型火箭開發週期的 80%。 「當然，火箭工程師會對我生氣，但你可以將其簡化為一個大型油箱供給發動機，」他談到火箭時說道。
historyItems.originalTitle: Building a rocket is hard. AST SpaceMobile thinks it’s “simple.”
historyItems.originalSummary: During an hour-long event on Thursday, Abel Avellan, the founder and chief executive of the telecommunications company AST SpaceMobile, laid out his vision for developing a large rocket to launch his Bluebird satellites into orbit. Avellan emphasized, over and over again, that AST plans to build a “simple” rocket. He paraphrased SpaceX founder Elon Musk several times, saying, “the best part is no part.” Avellan emphasized that AST has already procured engines for its proposed Blacklift rocket, asserting that engine development accounts for 80 percent of a typical rocket’s development cycle. “Of course rocket engineers are going to get mad with me, but you can simplify it as a big tank feeding engines,” he said of the rocket. “So big tanks—we know how to do them. We know how to do them. We know how to do them in composite.” I am not a rocket engineer, and I am not mad at Avellan. But he sure seems to be substantially underestimating the challenge of building rockets. Avellan also has a problem. AST SpaceMobile appears to be successful in building very large satellites, Bluebirds, that are capable of providing direct-to-cell capability from an orbit about 550km above Earth. The problem is there is a commercial launch crunch, and the company is struggling to get its satellites on orbit today, and projects to do so into the future. “We’re not doing this thing because we like rockets,” he said during the presentation. “We’re not doing this thing because we want to be in the launch business. We want this because we have so much demand of our satellites, and as you have seen it, we cannot get enough launches.” The Blacklift rocket will be “simple,” he said, because it will be solely tailored to lift five Bluebird satellites into low-Earth orbit at a time. It will have 20 metric tons of lift capacity, a reusable first stage, and launch twice a month from a pad at Wallops Flight Facility in Virginia that formerly served the Antares rocket. It will have all composite tanks and three stages. And, Avellan said, it will be ready to launch in 2028. If that timeline sounds preposterous, that’s because it is. However, Avellan believes AST has a workaround: It is committed to spending $1.3 billion to acquire enough engines for the first three Blacklift launches from Firefly Aerospace, as well as a license to manufacture additional engines over time. He is basing this argument on the Miranda first stage engine, which he said is “ready to fly.” But that’s not quite true. However, Miranda has not yet completed its formal qualification campaign, much less flown on an orbital rocket. Firefly chief executive Jason Kim said this week that qualification testing remains underway. Moreover, little is known publicly about the readiness of the upper stage engine, Vira, that AST is also acquiring from Firefly for its rocket.

historyItems.title: Ondas 在以色列上下了 10 億美元的重註。過去一年的投資
historyItems.summary: Ondas 自主系統技術長兼總工程師 Judith Hocherman-Frommer 博士在特拉維夫博覽會舉行的 UVID DroneTech 2026 會議上宣布，Ondas 已在以色列投資 10 億美元。她表示：「對以色列的投資正變得至關重要。」她補充說，這家美國公司在過去 18 個月內收購了 27 家國防科技公司，其中大多數是以色列公司。
historyItems.originalTitle: Ondas bets big on Israel with $1b. investment over past year
historyItems.originalSummary: Ondas has invested $1 billion in Israel, Dr. Judith Hocherman-Frommer, CTO and chief engineer of Ondas Autonomous Systems, announced at the UVID DroneTech 2026 conference at Expo Tel Aviv. “Investment in Israel is becoming mission critical,” she said, adding that the US-based company has acquired 27 defense-tech companies over the past 18 months, the majority being Israeli companies. The others are from the United States or Europe."We do not only acquire companies; we invest in each one to maximize its capabilities and create opportunities for collaboration among them to solve operational challenges in real time,” she added.The acquisitions are part of Ondas' broader push to build a vertically integrated defense technology company spanning the development, manufacturing, and deployment of autonomous systems. Its portfolio includes autonomous drones, counter-UAS systems, robotic ground platforms, unmanned aircraft, and systems for intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance missions.The company's motto, she said, is “Bots before boots,” with autonomous systems leading and clearing the way ahead of the warfighter.According to Hocherman-Frommer, threats are evolving at a pace not seen before, within months rather than years, and therefore require fast, practical responses as well as strong integration between Israel's operational innovation and global manufacturing and deployment infrastructures.The modern battlefield is creating “a democratization of low-cost threats at massive scale, asymmetric warfare, and a constant learning race that demands flexibility and rapid adaptation. At the same time, these realities are colliding with multi-year development cycles and legacy architectures on the ground."In response, the defense industry needs to change its operating model, as “the response to rapidly evolving threats can no longer rely on development programs that take years to complete, nor on expensive, standalone missiles designed to counter swarms of low-cost drones."Instead, "There must be a shift toward developing simpler and faster systems, manufacturing large quantities at high quality and affordable cost, and advancing toward autonomy, where systems operate independently while human operators provide high-level oversight."“Speed is the new strategic advantage,” she stressed.Digital BatHocherman-Frommer's comments came just days after Ondas announced that it had received a purchase order under its Digital Bat program, a next-generation tactical attack drone designed to meet what the company believes could become demand for tens of thousands of affordable autonomous strike systems. The company said the order marks a transition from development toward serial production and large-scale manufacturing. Ondas said it plans to leverage its pending acquisition of ARAN Defense, an Israeli engineering and manufacturing company, to establish dedicated production lines capable of manufacturing thousands of systems. The acquisition is expected to add engineering, industrialization, systems integration, supply-chain management, and manufacturing capabilities to Ondas' growing defense portfolio.The Digital Bat program is expected to be led by Airobotic

historyItems.originalTitle: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SPCX) stock price, news, quote and history
historyItems.originalSummary: Baron Capital , an investment management company, released its third-quarter 2026 investor letter for its "Baron Global Opportunity Fund". The letter can be downloaded here . The fund gained 3.3% (Institutional Shares) in the quarter, outperforming the 1.6% gain for the MSCI ACWI Index (the Index) and the 0.5% decline for the MSCI ACWI Growth Index, the Fund's benchmarks. YTD, the Fund is up 24.6% vs. 13.0% and 10.1% gains for the benchmarks, respectively. Strong stock selection and sector allocation drove 172 bps of outperformance in the quarter. Information Technology and Health Care led sector returns, while Developed Markets led regional gains. The Fund remains optimistic about the potential of AI and the Space Economy despite geopolitical uncertainties and rising interest rates. Guided by its long-term strategy, the Fund remains optimistic about its portfolio's prospects and is patiently seeking new opportunities that trade at attractive discounts to intrinsic value. Additionally, reviewing the Fund's top five holdings could help identify its best picks for 2026.

historyItems.originalTitle: Viavi Solutions, Innio, Construction Partners, Gibraltar, and Lennar shares are falling, what you need to know
historyItems.originalSummary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after hotter-than-expected October inflation data sparked fresh concerns that persistent price pressures could prompt the Federal Reserve to deliver larger interest rate increases. According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers climbed 0.4 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in October 2026. Meanwhile, core inflation, which measures all items excluding volatile food and energy costs, advanced 0.3 percent. The higher-than-anticipated figures dampened investor sentiment across Wall Street, as persistent price pressures suggest the central bank may need to keep borrowing costs elevated for longer than previously anticipated. Rising interest rates typically weigh on corporate valuations by increasing borrowing expenses and diminishing the present value of future earnings. As Treasury yields surged following the government data release, equities faced broad-based downward pressure, highlighting market sensitivity to persistent macroeconomic headwinds. The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks. Among others, the following stocks were impacted: Innio’s shares are extremely volatile and have had 39 moves greater than 5% over the last year. In that context, today’s move indicates the market considers this news meaningful but not something that would fundamentally change its perception of the business. historyItems.originalTitle: Ge Vernova Inc Stock (GEV) Opened Down by 7.06% on Nov 10: Key Drivers Unveiled
historyItems.originalSummary: Ge Vernova Inc (GEV) opened down by 7.06%. The Utilities sector is down by 1.54%. The company underperformed the industry. Top 3 stocks by turnover in the sector: Ge Vernova Inc (GEV) down 7.06%; Nextera Energy Inc (NEE) down 0.71%; Eversource Energy (ES) down 0.75%. GE Vernova experienced pronounced downward pressure during the session, driven primarily by aggressive profit-taking and multiple compression across the power generation and electrical infrastructure sectors. After an extended period of outperformance fueled by the structural narrative surrounding artificial intelligence data center power demand and global grid modernization, elevated expectations have heightened sensitivity to any friction in project execution and capital expenditure cycles. A key catalyst behind the sell-off centers on renewed scrutiny over segment profitability, particularly surrounding the wind division. Persistent challenges in offshore wind project delivery, supply chain bottlenecks, and contract restructuring risks continue to act as an overhang on consolidated margins. While the company has made meaningful progress in de-risking its legacy offshore backlog, institutional investors remain cautious regarding the potential for further margin dilution or unexpected warranty charges before the segment achieves sustainable profitability. Simultaneously, broader industry dynamics within gas power and electrification equipment point to a pause in momentum. Despite robust order backlogs and favorable pricing power for heavy-duty gas turbines and grid solutions, market participants are increasingly focused on multi-year delivery timelines and the potential for utility customers to face regulatory or interconnection delays. Any indication of a moderated conversion pace from order book to revenue recognition leaves richly valued names susceptible to rapid valuation resets. Macroeconomic conditions and institutional positioning amplified the downward move. Upward pressure on benchmark yields and shifting expectations regarding federal energy policy and clean energy incentives prompted institutional desks to trim exposure to capital-intensive, high-valuation industrial names. Quantitative strategies and portfolio rebalancing away from momentum leadership into defensive value further accelerated intraday selling volume. Looking ahead, institutional focus will center on margin expansion trajectory within Electrification, cash flow conversion in the Power segment, and clear evidence of de-risking within Wind operations. While the long-term secular demand for power generation and transmission capacity remains intact, near-term price discovery will likely depend on management demonstrating sustained operating leverage and execution consistency across all business units. historyItems.originalTitle: Will it snow? Latest on potential nor’easter headed for Philly, NYC and DC
historyItems.originalSummary: An incoming storm is set to deliver the first snow of the season to parts of New England, though the Boston area will mainly contend with a cold, windswept rain starting Thursday. Several inches of wet snow are forecast for the highest elevations of Massachusetts and Northern New England. This system is set to eventually slide off the Mid-Atlantic coast late Thursday and develop into a nor’easter, bringing more rain, wind, and some wet snow through Friday. But unlike the other nor’easters we’ve seen this fall, we should avoid major impacts like coastal flooding. This one is more of an inconvenience for Greater Boston and Southern New England. • Snow — This storm holds a decent shot of delivering a coating to a couple of inches of snow along Route 2, west of I-495, and a coating to 3 inches of wet snow in a few higher-elevation spots across the Berkshires, northern Worcester County, and most of Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine, with isolated spots seeing 3 to 6 inches across the highest terrain. • Rain — For the lower elevations and by the coast, it just won’t be that cold for widespread snow. Greater Boston should end up with about a half inch of cold, windswept rain, a lot less than what we experienced last week . The same rain scenario plays out as you head south to Cape Cod, the South Coast, and Rhode Island.

historyItems.originalTitle: Kratos and Seagate Space Partner to Advance Mobile Offshore Launch Capabilities for National Security Missions
historyItems.originalSummary: A photo accompanying this announcement is available at https://www.globenewswire.com/NewsRoom/AttachmentNg/6bce8d6c-8a04-4d2e-bad7-c7d636371732 SAN DIEGO, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: KTOS), a technology company in defense, national security, and global markets, today announced a long-term agreement with Seagate Space for use of the company’s initial Gateway ™ offshore launch platform. The agreement supports Kratos’ planned first mission from the platform in 2027, with multiple additional launches anticipated in subsequent years. The partnership aligns Kratos’ mission of being first to market and proven record of delivering real, mission-relevant products and systems, including hypersonic test and other vehicles, rocket systems, propulsion technologies, target vehicles, and launch services, with Seagate Space’s modular, mobile offshore platform infrastructure. The Gateway series vessels are designed to provide flexible sea-based platforms to complement traditional land-based launch sites and test ranges. The announcement coincides with Seagate Space’s execution of its first Gateway platform construction contract, advancing into physical construction and toward future operational readiness.

historyItems.summary: 截至中午 12:31，卡特彼勒 (NYSE:CAT) 股價上漲 6.61%，至 595.53 美元。美國東部時間 11 月 9 日星期一常規交易中，有報導稱 Anthropic 同意斥資 34 億美元為其數據中心購買 1.7 吉瓦燃氣發電機。這些設備來自 Caterpillar 的訂單，該訂單是總部位於聖安東尼奧的 OnePWR Solutions 大約兩年前下達的，但需要融資才能完成。據 Investing.com 引述《金融時報》報道，Anthropic 接手了訂單，而不是收購 OnePWR。
historyItems.originalTitle: Caterpillar Stocks Jump 6.61% as Anthropic Takes Over $3.4 Billion Generator Order
historyItems.originalSummary: Caterpillar ( NYSE:CAT ) shares jumped 6.61% to $595.53 as of 12:31 p.m. ET on Monday, November 9, in regular trading, after reports that Anthropic agreed to spend $3.4 billion on 1.7 gigawatts of gas-fired generators for its data centers. The equipment comes from Caterpillar orders that San Antonio-based OnePWR Solutions placed about two years ago but needed financing to complete. Anthropic took over the orders rather than buying OnePWR, according to the Financial Times as cited by Investing.com. Warning! GuruFocus has detected 6 Warning Signs with SBUX. Is CAT fairly valued? historyItems.originalTitle: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO’s alleged relationship with Chinese spy
historyItems.originalSummary: The artificial intelligence semiconductor giant Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into its CEO, Jensen Huang, after he acknowledged a romantic relationship with businesswoman Alice Huang — also known as Huang Le — who is suspected of spying for the Chinese government. The tech mogul is not only one of the most powerful business leaders in the United States and the artificial intelligence sector; he also maintains a close relationship with U.S. President Donald Trump, who said Sunday that Huang is an “honorable guy” and should remain in his position. The executive, who will continue to lead the company — at least for the time being — sent a message to the tech giant’s employees on Sunday after U.S. media outlets published new details about the romantic relationship. In it, he admitted to being unfaithful to his wife. “I owe my family and all of you an apology... There is no excuse for what I did,” he wrote. “To my wife and family: I love you. I know an apology cannot undo what I have done. I hope our family will heal and that, over time, I can earn back your trust.” The explosive situation began to come to light last month, when The New York Times broke the story about suspicions that Jensen Huang may have been the target of a Chinese espionage operation through his relationship with Huang Le. U.S. officials had concluded last year — as reported by the Times and later by other outlets — that Alice Huang, then a senior executive at Megaspeed International, had shared information with the Chinese government while collaborating with Nvidia, the world’s most valuable company, on the construction of data centers in Asia. U.S. investigators had launched their probe amid suspicions that Megaspeed helped Beijing gain access to advanced artificial intelligence semiconductors, the shipment of which to China is prohibited. The Singapore-based company had purchased enormous quantities of these chips from Nvidia: $4.8 billion worth over the past two years. Alice Huang was responsible for these purchasing operations at Megaspeed. Her biography indicates that she worked in China as a television journalist before becoming an executive at the Singapore-based company. According to the Times, last spring Secretary of State Marco Rubio oversaw the drafting of a classified memorandum detailing intelligence that showed Alice Huang had been recruited by the Chinese Ministry of State Security to lure Jensen Huang into a trap. That document circulated shortly before Trump’s visit to China in May. historyItems.originalTitle: When will it snow in New York? Latest forecast shows late-week storm potential
historyItems.originalSummary: New Yorkers could get a more noticeable taste of winter late this week as colder air spreads into the state and a developing storm potentially brings rain and snow. The latest forecasts do not support calling this a major statewide snowstorm. However, the National Weather Service is now monitoring a late-week system that could produce measurable snow in higher elevations of central and eastern New York. Lower elevations and coastal communities are more likely to receive rain, although the forecast remains uncertain. Before that system arrives, much of the state will experience seasonable to relatively mild weather. Scattered rain showers will affect parts of upstate New York through Monday, followed by a period of quieter weather in many areas. Some snow could reach parts of New York late this week, but it is too early to determine where it will accumulate or whether the storm will become disruptive. The National Weather Service in Binghamton said a clipper-type system could move into the Ohio Valley Wednesday and Thursday before potentially helping form a coastal storm by Friday. The forecast includes chances for rain and snow Thursday and Friday, with some rain and snow showers potentially lingering into Saturday. Higher elevations would have the best chance of seeing measurable snow if the storm tracks south of the region, allowing colder air to become established. The Catskills and higher terrain of central New York are among the areas to watch. Uncertainty remains high because forecast models differ on the storm's track. Even relatively small changes could determine whether a location receives snow, a rain-snow mix or primarily rain. The National Weather Service's winter weather forecasts provide snowfall projections extending out to 72 hours, including expected accumulation and lower- and higher-end possibilities. Western New York will remain unsettled into Monday, but the precipitation is initially expected to fall as rain.

Vorago Technologies brings components built for harsh environments such as aerospace and defense, including high radiation and extreme temperatures. The Blacklift launch system is being developed with Firefly Aerospace under a dedicated technology and engine agreement. The company aims for more independent and cost-aware access to orbit by pairing in house launch capability with its satellite platform. The new Blacklift partnership with Firefly only captures part of the story around AST SpaceMobile's broader capital and execution risks. historyItems.summary: AST SpaceMobile 將使用 Firefly 引擎建造自己的可重複使用 Blacklift 火箭，導致 Firefly 股價上漲 37%，而 AST 則達到 52 週低點。 Alphabet 持有約 900 萬股 A​​ST 股票，價值約 2.89 億美元，因為 AST 在季度虧損 2.31 億美元後面臨火箭般的成本和稀釋。 Firefly 的引擎交易金額高達 13 億美元，AST 預付了約 8 億美元的現金和股票，稀釋了現有股東的股權。 AST SpaceMobile（納斯達克股票代碼：ASTS）在 2026 年 11 月 6 日開盤前表示，將建造自己的火箭 Blacklift，以便於 2028 年底開始發射藍鳥衛星。
historyItems.originalTitle: AST SpaceMobile To Build New Blacklift Rocket
historyItems.originalSummary: AST SpaceMobile will build its own reusable Blacklift rocket with Firefly engines, sending Firefly shares up 37% while AST hit a 52-week low. Alphabet held about 9 million AST shares, worth roughly $289 million, as AST takes on rocket costs and dilution after a $231 million quarterly loss. Firefly's engine deal tops $1.3 billion, with AST paying about $800 million upfront in cash and shares that dilute current holders. Before the open on November 6, 2026, AST SpaceMobile ( NASDAQ:ASTS ) said it will build its own rocket, Blacklift, to launch its BlueBird satellites starting in late 2028. Firefly Aerospace ( NASDAQ:FLY ) will supply the engines.

historyItems.originalTitle: Why Are Western Digital (WDC) Shares Falling On AI Data Center Policy Risk?
historyItems.originalSummary: Western Digital (NasdaqGS:WDC) shares fell alongside wider US tech on 5 November 2026 after renewed Democratic election momentum. Investors reacted to signals from leading Democrats that large AI data centers could face tighter federal oversight and permitting rules. Policy discussions now include potential caps on new data center projects in key US regions that host hyperscale AI facilities. The prospect of stricter AI data center regulation frames a new policy risk for Western Digital. This research explores that risk further. We have also flagged 4 other big wins for Western Digital. This storage supplier is far from the only business tied to AI infrastructure growth, so it is worth scanning peers through 53 AI infrastructure stocks .

historyItems.title: 馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 的特斯拉 (Tesla) 和 SpaceX 在中期選舉後總市值損失超過 4,200 億美元
historyItems.summary: 週四下午，SpaceX和特斯拉股價分別下跌約9%和11%，投資人擔心馬斯克可能面臨新的國會調查，其公司可能在美國中期選舉後遭遇更嚴格的監管。似乎選舉結果還不夠，馬斯克投入近5億美元投入的共和黨被逐出美國國會，交易所的動盪或許只是這位世界首富懊惱的開始。自周二收盤以來，SpaceX 和特斯拉的市值總和損失超過 4,200 億美元。 根據 CNBC 報導，截至週四收盤，SpaceX 和特斯拉的虧損額與科技業更廣泛的拋售同時發生。
historyItems.originalTitle: Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX lose over $420 billion in combined market cap after midterms
historyItems.originalSummary: SpaceX and Tesla shares fell about 9% and 11%, respectively, on Thursday afternoon as investors worried that Elon Musk could face new congressional investigations and his companies could encounter stricter regulation after the US midterm elections.As if the election results were not enough, which saw the Republican Party, which Musk poured nearly half a billion into, being pummelled out of the US Congress, the turmoil at the bourse may just be the beginning of the world's richest man's chagrin.The declines, which coincided with a broader technology-sector sell-off, pushed combined market-cap losses for SpaceX and Tesla to more than $420 billion since Tuesday’s close.As per a CNBC report, by the close of trading on Thursday, SpaceX and Tesla had lost a combined approximately $456 billion in market capitalisation.According to Forbes, which keeps a reliable database of the richest in the world, Musk’s net worth, which exceeded $1 trillion after SpaceX’s initial public offering in June, has now fallen below $800 billion. He lost about $90 billion over the past week but remains the world’s richest person.Musk was the largest donor to Republican candidates and causes during the midterms, contributing more than $470 million, the Financial Times first reported.Despite his support for the GOP’s fundraising efforts, most of the candidates Musk backed lost their races.Democrats secured control of both the House and Senate. In Texas, home to both Tesla and SpaceX, Democratic Sen.-elect James Talarico and Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa defeated longtime Musk allies: state Attorney General Ken Paxton and Gov. Greg Abbott.Tesla and SpaceX are expanding their AI infrastructure in Texas and plan to build Terafab, a massive complex in Grimes County that will house both a data center and a sprawling semiconductor factory.According to company job postings, SpaceX also intends to develop a “supercomputer” at Starbase, its launch facility and company town in Texas.Deutsche Bank analysts, who spoke to CNBC, have warned that SpaceX’s computing expansion in Texas may face delays. They said the company could need to raise capital spending to comply with stricter regulations expected to govern data centre development.CNN first reported, citing an aide to a Democratic senator, that Musk and SpaceX had been instructed to retain records related to restrictions on a military version of Starlink in Ukraine. Those restrictions limited Ukraine’s ability to defend itself against Russian attacks.Regulatory scrutiny could also jeopardise Musk’s proposed merger of SpaceX and Tesla, an idea he has promoted while acknowledging that it would first require shareholder approval.Read Also: Hyundai cars can now cut your insurance premium by up to 15% if you drive safely

historyItems.originalTitle: US proposes space launch rule changes in potential boost for SpaceX
historyItems.originalSummary: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) proposed changes to commercial space launch and re-entry rules. The move aims to reduce licensing delays and support a rapid rise in launch activity across the country.The proposals could particularly benefit Elon Musk’s SpaceX and Jeff Bezos’s Blue Origin. Both companies operate high-frequency launch programs and require repeated regulatory approvals for rockets, satellites and reusable vehicles..What the FAA Proposes.The FAA has put forward three key changes. First, operators would gain flexibility to switch off a rocket’s flight-termination system earlier in a mission and reactivate it later, provided they meet the agency’s safety conditions for that phase.Second, the regulator proposes clearer rules on when a launch must be aborted. The revised language would explain how companies should assess the risks of ending a flight early versus allowing it to continue after it can no longer achieve its objective.Third, the FAA wants to simplify how operators assess spacecraft breakup during uncontrolled re-entry. Companies could use existing debris analyses to show that fragments are unlikely to cause multiple casualties on the ground..A Boost for SpaceX.The changes would make launch approvals easier for SpaceX and Blue Origin, according to the FAA. SpaceX, which dominates US commercial launch activity, stands to gain the most since it conducts missions at a far higher cadence than its rivals.Faster approvals could help SpaceX expand Starlink satellite deployments, accelerate Starship development and reduce waiting periods between missions. Blue Origin could also benefit as it scales its New Glenn rocket program.The proposals follow earlier FAA moves to allow electronic launch applications, combine three safety analyses into one submission and give operators greater flexibility in demonstrating safe operations..Preparing for Higher Launch Volumes.The White House wants at least 1,000 commercial launches and re-entries annually by 2030. That target compares with 178 launches last year and marks a tenfold increase from 2013.To manage this growth, the FAA is expanding its Office of Commercial Space Transportation. It has named an associate administrator and is hiring aerospace engineers to speed up safety reviews and mission authorisations.The agency also plans a broader overhaul of its space-licensing framework beginning in 2027. The initiative signals a shift towards a more predictable and scalable regulatory system for the commercial space economy.Also Read: Qualcomm to Supply 5G Technology for SpaceX's Nationwide Network.Join our WhatsApp Channel to get the latest news, exclusives and videos on WhatsApp

historyItems.originalTitle: Morgan Stanley Downgrades Cisco On AI Impacting Gross Margins
historyItems.originalSummary: Morgan Stanley's Meta Marshall downgraded Cisco after a 43% rally, warning that AI hardware margin pressure leaves less upside while Ciena and Arista fall harder. The post-midterm AI selloff has spread from chips to optical suppliers Lumentum and Coherent, as fears grow that Democratic control of Congress will curb infrastructure spending. Cisco's diversified customer base cushions its drop, while Ciena's 53% hyperscaler revenue and Arista's 64x valuation leave both more exposed to AI sentiment swings.

historyItems.title: 美光在勞資糾紛後暫停了價值 45 億美元的台灣工廠的建設
historyItems.summary: 知情人士透露，由於曠日持久的勞資糾紛，美光科技公司暫停了在台灣建設記憶體晶片工廠的計劃，這讓關鍵人工智慧 (AI) 組件主要生產基地的命運受到質疑。知情人士稱，這家美國公司幾乎停止了在桃園的一家工廠的建設。由於討論是私下進行的，因此要求匿名。高層擔心越來越多的不確定性，包括與當地工會達成的協議被推翻的風險。知情人士稱，美光科技已向台灣官員和一家供應商通報暫停在該市建設的計畫。
historyItems.originalTitle: Micron Pauses Work on $4.5 Billion Taiwan Plant After Labor Spat
historyItems.originalSummary: Micron Technology Inc has suspended plans for a memory chip plant in Taiwan due to a protracted labor dispute, according to people familiar with the matter, throwing into question the fate of a major production base for crucial artificial intelligence (AI) components. The US company has all but halted construction of a plant in Taoyuan, said the people, who asked not to be identified because the deliberations are private. Executives are concerned about mounting uncertainties, including the risk that an agreement with a local labor union will get overturned. Micron has informed Taiwanese officials and a supplier about its plans to suspend construction in the city, the people said. Tensions between Micron and its workers flared this year after employees demanded higher compensation, seeking more of the record profits generated from the AI build-out. The potential disruption to Micron’s plans in Taiwan — an island that produces three-fifths of the US firm’s conventional chips — threatens to further cloud a market already grappling with endemic shortages of memory. Micron — which has invested close to US$50 billion in Taiwan over three decades — had planned on making high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and DRAM at the new Taoyuan plant using top-end equipment from ASML Holding NV. While it isn’t considered a giant facility by modern standards, those components are intertwined with Nvidia Corp accelerators and the global AI data center boom, and in such short supply that prices are skyrocketing. “Taiwan plays an important role in Micron’s global footprint, and our operations today continue as normal,” Micron said in a statement, without addressing questions about the Taoyuan complex. “We are confident in maintaining business continuity for our customers.” Micron secured a deal with the bigger of its two unions last month, but the company may need to renegotiate because some employees are balking at the terms, according to the people. The suspension raises the possibility Micron will reconsider plans for its broader manufacturing hub in Taiwan, which helps it compete with South Korea’s Samsung Electronics Co and SK Hynix Inc, and China’s CXMT Corp (長鑫存儲). Micron had budgeted US$3 billion to US$4.5 billion toward the Taoyuan complex, which included purchases of ASML gear, one of the people said. There’s still some minor work being done on the site to ensure its safety, but construction will freeze after that, the people added. Dubbed Fab 11E, it was previously scheduled to come online in 2028. Micron is Taiwan’s largest foreign investor, and it would be a major blow to the island if the company scaled back there. Taiwan’s economy and stock market have gotten a boost from the AI boom, with the likes of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. building plants at an unprecedented pace. Yet its viability as a long-term investment destination is at risk from potential Chinese military intervention.

historyItems.originalTitle: Viavi Solutions (NASDAQ:VIAV) reports bullish Q3 CY2026, provides optimistic revenue guidance for next quarter
historyItems.originalSummary: Viavi Solutions (VIAV) is back on investor screens after reporting fiscal first quarter results that topped analyst expectations on both revenue and earnings, accompanied by positive guidance and a new US$500 million share repurchase plan. Recent trading has been choppy for Viavi Solutions, with the share price down 14.7% over the past week and 37.4% over the last month. However, the year-to-date share price return of 61.9% and three-year total shareholder return of about 2.6x point to stronger longer-term momentum, which recent earnings, product updates and the fresh buyback plan are now testing in a more volatile way.

historyItems.originalTitle: Amazon plans its first data centers in Washington state as residents raise concerns
historyItems.originalSummary: Amazon Web Services is the company behind plans to develop a data center campus with up to 21 buildings at West Richland’s sprawling Lewis & Clark Ranch. Monday, AWS confirmed it is the actual buyer behind the $264 million deal in a phone call. It said that such arrangements are standard.

historyItems.summary: 加州歐文，2026 年 11 月 3 日 (環球通訊社) -- 高效能射頻、精密定時、電源管理和混合訊號解決方案的全球領導者 Skyworks Solutions, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SWKS）今天公佈了截至 2026 年 10 月 2 日的第四財季和 2026 財年業績。
historyItems.originalTitle: Skyworks Stock Sinks as Android Woes Delay the Qorvo’s Merger Payoff
historyItems.originalSummary: IRVINE, Calif., Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Skyworks Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: SWKS), a global leader in high-performance RF, precision timing, power management and mixed-signal solutions, today reported fourth fiscal quarter and fiscal year 2026 results for the period ended Oct. 2, 2026. Skyworks’ revenue for its fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 was $1,046 million. Skyworks’ GAAP diluted earnings per share were $0.15 and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share were $1.28. For fiscal year 2026, Skyworks’ revenue was $3.96 billion, with GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.14 and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $5.05. “Today marks a new chapter for Skyworks,” said Phil Brace, chief executive officer and president of Skyworks. “Combining with Qorvo gives us the scale and the technology breadth to lead the next era of wireless, as AI moves from the infrastructure to the devices, vehicles and machines around us. In Smartphone, our portfolio now spans the RF front-end, from power management to the antenna, as 5G-Advanced and 6G drive a new cycle of RF complexity. In Diversified Growth Markets, our complementary RF GaN, power, and timing solutions expand our reach across Physical AI and Connected Edge, Defense and Aerospace, Infrastructure, and Automotive. Our focus now is execution: delivering for our customers, achieving $500 million or more of annual cost synergies and building a stronger, more diversified Skyworks.” Basis of Presentation and New Revenue Categories “Because our combination with Qorvo closed after the end of our fiscal fourth quarter, our reported September-quarter results are Skyworks standalone,” said Philip Carter, chief financial officer and senior vice president of Skyworks. “Combined September-quarter revenue of approximately $1.98 billion, which includes an additional week in Qorvo’s fiscal quarter, provides the starting point for our first quarter as a combined company. Beginning with our first fiscal quarter of 2027, we will report on a fully combined basis, with Smartphone and Diversified Growth Markets as our revenue categories.”

historyItems.originalTitle: Shares of Elon Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX Tumble After Republican Losses
historyItems.originalSummary: Thank you for your patience while we verify access. Elon Musk spent nearly $500 million supporting Republican candidates in the midterm elections, especially in his home state, Texas. After Democrats won sweeping victories, gaining control of both houses of Congress and capturing other important state races, shares of SpaceX and Tesla, which are both run by Mr. Musk, fell sharply on Wednesday. Tesla’s stock dropped when markets opened, and closed down more than 3 percent. SpaceX, which conducted a blockbuster public offering in June, followed a similar pattern, and was nearly 4 percent lower by the end of trading. The declines stood out among tech stocks, as Meta, Microsoft, Google and the wider stock market rallied at the start of trading. SpaceX and Tesla are exploring a merger , which could be complicated by a Congress controlled by Democrats, some of whom have already signaled their intent to investigate the world’s richest person and his companies. In recent years, Mr. Musk has antagonized Democrats, spending heavily to elect President Trump, involving himself deeply in firing federal workers and shutting down government agencies while aligning his companies’ interests with those of the administration. “They are going to need to plant new forests for all of the subpoenas we’ll be printing,” Senator Edward J. Markey, Democrat of Massachusetts, posted on X on Tuesday night about potential hearings for technology executives.

historyItems.title: 民主黨橫掃中期選舉後，馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 旗下 SpaceX 和特斯拉的股價在盤前下跌
historyItems.summary: 11 月 3 日星期二，民主黨在 2026 年中期選舉中大獲全勝，馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 旗下公司 SpaceX 和特斯拉的股價在第二天早上暴跌。 《紐約時報》11 月 4 日星期三報導稱，開盤時，特斯拉股價下跌超過 5%，SpaceX 股價下跌超過 7%，隨後收復了部分跌幅。據該媒體報道，這位 55 歲的世界首富在中期選舉中投入了至少 4.74 億美元，試圖讓共和黨繼續掌權，這比美國選舉週期中任何捐助者花費的錢都多，這還不包括為自己競選公職提供資金的候選人。
historyItems.originalTitle: Shares in Elon Musk’s SpaceX, Tesla Fall Premarket After Democrats Sweep Midterms
historyItems.originalSummary: As Democrats swept the 2026 midterm elections on Tuesday, November 3, shares of Elon Musk 's companies SpaceX and Tesla tumbled the following morning. The New York Times reported on Wednesday, November 4, that when markets opened, Tesla's stock fell more than 5 percent, and SpaceX fell more than 7 percent before recovering some of those losses. The world's richest man, 55, poured at least $474 million into the midterms in an attempt to keep Republicans in power, spending more money than any donor in a U.S. election cycle, not counting candidates who have funded their own runs for office, according to the outlet.
